facts.source_name: Storyboard18 (from Urban Company DRHP)
facts.notes: Revenue here is UC's take (commission plus services), not GMV, which makes it comparable to PetDoorStep net platform revenue. Coverage of the 2025 DRHP. No CAC in rupees was disclosed in the sources found.

facts.claim: Urban Company's refer-and-earn gives the referrer Rs 100 after the friend's first service, and the friend gets Rs 100 off services. Invites are shared via WhatsApp or an in-app link.
facts.source_name: Zoutons coupon aggregator
facts.notes: Not from an official UC page. Listing validity ran to Jun/Jul 2026, so the current terms are unconfirmed. Benchmark for a PetDoorStep referral credit of Rs 100-200 per side, paid only after the referred customer's first completed service.

facts.claim: Median e-commerce referral conversion is 3-5%, and leading programmes reach double that. Vendor data claims double-sided rewards raise participation by about 29%.
facts.source_name: Rivo - Referral Program Statistics & Benchmarks 2026
facts.notes: Global vendor benchmarks (2026 article). Geography field set to India only as the schema requires; the data is not India-specific. No India home-services referral share was found. Model referral-sourced new customers at 10-20% of new customers once the base exceeds about 300 (assumption, not sourced).

facts.claim: 2026 Indian benchmarks for Instagram ads: CPM Rs 45-350 and CPC Rs 6-55. Reels CPM is Rs 45-140, Stories Rs 80-200 and Feed Rs 150-350. Reels typically run 25-40% cheaper than feed.
facts.source_name: upGrowth - Instagram ads pricing India 2026
facts.notes: Agency blog with unclear methodology. Another source: Facebook feed CPM Rs 50-400 (productgrowth.in). Superads median India CPC is USD 0.17-0.18 (about Rs 15). Validate with your own Rs 500-1,000/day test.

facts.topic: Meta ads - Tier-2 CPM and seasonality
facts.claim: Indian Meta CPMs by city tier: metros USD 2.50-3.50, Tier-2 USD 1.50-2.50, Tier-3 USD 0.80-1.80. Tier-1 is 2-3x Tier-3. October-December is peak season, with CPMs 25-50% above average. Meta India CPL is listed at USD 1.50-12.
facts.source_name: Sotros Infotech - Paid Social Ads Benchmarks India 2026
facts.notes: About Rs 130-220 CPM at roughly Rs 88/USD (my conversion). Ludhiana is not listed but fits the Tier-2 band. Launching in Oct-Dec 2026 means Diwali/Q4 CPM inflation.

facts.topic: Meta ads - cost per lead (home services)
facts.claim: From 2025 agency client data, Meta lead-ad CPL in India is Rs 100-250 for home services and Rs 180-380 (or Rs 150-350) for healthcare and clinics. A general range of Rs 40-150 per lead is also cited.
facts.source_name: OwlClaw - Meta Ads Benchmarks India
facts.notes: Single agency dataset. Derived CAC: at Rs 100-250 CPL and 25-40% lead-to-first-booking conversion (assumed), paid CAC is about Rs 250-1,000. Model a base paid CAC of Rs 500-800.

facts.claim: Indian Google Ads CPC for local services (plumber, salon, dentist) is about Rs 8-35 per click. A local service business needs Rs 15,000-30,000 a month to generate 80-200 leads in a tight radius, at Rs 150-400 per lead. Below Rs 15,000 a month there is too little data to optimise.
facts.source_name: upGrowth - Google Ads pricing India 2026
facts.notes: No India-specific CPC was found for 'dog grooming near me'. Check Keyword Planner (INR, Ludhiana geo). OneCity puts local-service CPL at Rs 150-500. Tier-1 cities cost 35-50% more than Tier-2/3 (Sotros Infotech).

facts.claim: Since 1 July 2025, Meta has charged per delivered template message. The India marketing rate rose from Rs 0.7846 to Rs 0.8631 on 1 January 2026. Utility and authentication are about Rs 0.115 per message. All rates exclude 18% GST.
facts.source_name: WhAutomate; Spurnow; IBTimes India (citing Meta rate card)
facts.notes: Consistent across many secondary sources, but Meta's own page (developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing) could not be read directly. BSPs add 10-30% markup, e.g. Interakt about Rs 0.882 per marketing message and AiSensy about Rs 1.09. With GST, a marketing message costs about Rs 1.02. Authentication-international is Rs 2.4971.

facts.claim: From 1 October 2026, Meta charges for service messages (free-form replies inside the 24-hour window) and for utility templates sent in response inside that window, at about Rs 0.115 per message before GST. Reports cite 1,000 free service messages per business number per month. A payment method had to be added by 30 September 2026.
facts.source_name: IBTimes India; Zoho help; Alibaba Cloud; AiSensy blog
facts.notes: Sources conflict on the 1,000 free messages: ChatMaxima says Meta published no free allowance. AiSensy quotes Rs 0.145, which likely includes markup. Already in effect as of 2026-10-10. Applies to the API only, not the free WhatsApp Business app.

facts.claim: Meta's pricing documentation, updated 28 September 2026, says the free entry-point window opened by a Click-to-WhatsApp ad 'may remain open for up to 7 days' (previously 72 hours). All messages in that window are free. Click costs are set by the normal Meta auction plus 18% GST.
facts.value: up to 7 days free messaging after CTWA ad click
facts.source_name: Spurnow (citing Meta pricing documentation)
facts.notes: Makes CTWA ads the cheapest way to start conversations if the business uses the API. One vendor quotes CTWA clicks in India at about Rs 5-25. Sotros quotes B2B CTWA CPL of Rs 200-800, which is not comparable to B2C.

facts.claim: AiSensy's pricing from 1 July 2025: Basic Rs 1,500/month and Pro Rs 3,200/month plus GST (Rs 1,350 and Rs 2,880 a month when billed annually). Both include 1 owner and 5 agents; extra agents are Rs 750/month. Chatbot flows are an add-on at Rs 2,500/month for the first 5 flows.
facts.source_name: AiSensy help centre (official)
facts.notes: Meta message charges are billed on top. This is the cheapest credible official BSP plan found for the low-cost path.

facts.topic: WhatsApp BSP fees - Interakt, Wati, Gallabox
facts.claim: Interakt: Starter Rs 3,499/quarter or Rs 11,999/year (1 channel), Growth Rs 7,699/quarter, Advanced Rs 10,499/quarter, plus a 12-25% message markup. Wati: Growth Rs 2,499-2,699/month, Pro Rs 5,999-6,499. Gallabox: Growth about Rs 2,399/month billed yearly (other sources about Rs 5,999).
facts.source_name: Codingclave (Interakt); YCloud and RichAutomate (Wati); Zoko (Gallabox)
facts.notes: These are third-party summaries that conflict with each other. Check interakt.shop, wati.io and gallabox.com pricing pages before committing. Other URLs: https://www.ycloud.com/blog/wati-pricing and https://www.zoko.io/post/gallabox-pricing-whatsapp-automation

facts.claim: The free WhatsApp Business app limits each broadcast list to 256 recipients. You can create unlimited lists, but messages reach only contacts who have saved your number. Sending the same message to many lists quickly can trigger spam filters.
facts.source_name: Qiscus; Telecrm; ChatArchitect (vendor guides)
facts.notes: No official Meta help page was found. Sources mention monthly marketing caps for app accounts but give no official figure. The free app is enough for roughly the first 200-500 customers.

facts.claim: Indian nano creators (1K-10K followers) charge about Rs 2,000-8,000 per post or Reel (upGrowth 2026). Other sources give Rs 500-3,000 per post (Dazzlerr) and Rs 500-5,000 per Reel (Kofluence 2025). Nano engagement is typically 6-12%.
facts.source_name: upGrowth; Dazzlerr; Kofluence 2025 report preview
facts.notes: Kofluence: https://www.kofluence.com/2025-influencer-marketing-report-sneak-peek/ (India influencer economy Rs 3,000-3,500 cr; 1.8-2.3M Instagram creators). Pet nano creators in Chandigarh exist (e.g., ~9.6K followers, socialveins). An Ahmedabad Labrador account earned Rs 4,000/post (mansworldindia). Barter of a free groom (Rs 1,199-1,899 value) is the realistic route.

facts.claim: Indian micro creators (10K-100K followers) charge Rs 8,000-80,000 per deliverable, with beauty and fashion at Rs 25-60K. Lower benchmarks: Reels Rs 5,000-25,000 and posts Rs 3,000-15,000 (Dazzlerr 2026). A 45K-follower skincare creator charges about Rs 25,000 per Reel (Kofluence).
facts.source_name: upGrowth; Dazzlerr; Kofluence
facts.notes: Engagement and niche shift price 2-3x within a tier. Pet/local Ludhiana micro creators are likely at the lower end. Elev8or platform estimates (Rs 66-396/post) look implausibly low and were discarded.

facts.claim: Section 194R (Finance Act 2022) requires 10% TDS on benefits or perquisites, including free products or services given to influencers, above Rs 20,000 per recipient per year. ASCI guidelines (in force since 14 June 2021) treat gifted or barter content as needing disclosure (#ad, #collab, #gifted). CCPA can fine up to Rs 10 lakh for individuals and Rs 50 lakh for entities over misleading ads.
facts.source_name: IANS Life (194R); Sansa Legal / Jurigram (ASCI)
facts.notes: IANS article is from 2022. ASCI sources: https://www.sansalegal.com/post/asci-influencer-advertising-guidelines-2026-disclosure-rules-for-paid-content-and-ai-influencers. A CA must confirm current 194R applicability to a small proprietorship/LLP.

facts.claim: Indian bulk flyer printers list Rs 0.50 per piece (minimum 1,000) up to Rs 0.50-2 per piece. That puts 1,000 flyers at about Rs 500-2,000 before design, delivery and GST.
facts.source_name: ExportersIndia supplier listings
facts.notes: The listings don't specify A5 or 130gsm. Printo's A5 page (130gsm gloss, minimum 25) shows no price in search. Get 2-3 Ludhiana quotes; local offset printing for 5,000+ is usually cheaper per piece.

facts.claim: Indian newspaper pamphlet insertion costs about Rs 0.20-0.35 per piece for insertion only (Rs 200-350 per 1,000) in Delhi-NCR and other cities, with IndiaMART listings up to Rs 1.30. The Media Ant rack rates are about Rs 1.12-1.41 per pamphlet, with minimum billing of about Rs 10,000-12,800. Some vendors require 10,000 units.
facts.source_name: IndiaMART listings; The Media Ant; Smartads
facts.notes: No Ludhiana or Dainik Bhaskar rate card was found. Get a quote from the local newspaper hawker/distribution agent; inserting in specific affluent sectors' delivery routes is the efficient option. Media Ant: https://www.themediaant.com/nontraditional/newspaper-inserts-delhi-advertising/newspaper-insert

facts.claim: A printed 6x3 ft roll-up standee with stand costs about Rs 950-1,800 per piece on IndiaMART. QR stickers range from Rs 0.45 per piece (2x1 inch paper) to about Rs 10-20 per piece for vinyl or Paytm-style stickers.
facts.source_name: IndiaMART seller listings
facts.notes: Seller asking prices; GST treatment varies. QR sticker source: https://m.indiamart.com/proddetail/paytm-qr-code-stickers-custom-qr-code-printing-21026875897.html. Placing standees at partner vet clinics and pet shops is the main use.

facts.claim: RWA society advertising vendors list an RWA banner in Delhi at Rs 7,500/month (Adzone). Smartads lists Rs 38,000 per RWA for 3 months (non-lit, minimum 50 units) and Rs 6,000 per signage board per month.
facts.source_name: Smartads; Adzone Communications (IndiaMART)
facts.notes: These are metro agency rates. Ludhiana colonies and RWAs often allow notice-board posts free or for a small donation, or in return for a free camp. A free 'vaccination/grooming camp' in a society is a cheaper alternative (assumption).

facts.claim: Justdial's average annual subscription fee was Rs 18,000-20,000 (Inc42, Q1 FY24). Its advertising page in 2026 shows an indicative one-year Standard plan from Rs 100/day (about Rs 36,500/year). Justdial had 631,530 active paid campaigns at 31 March 2026.
facts.source_name: Inc42; Business Wire/yespress overview; Justdial investor presentation
facts.notes: Price varies by city, category and package. Free listing is available. Justdial says Tier II/III cities account for 63% of its searches (2023 report, cxotoday). Other URL: https://yespress.io/justdial

facts.claim: GADVASU (veterinary university, Ludhiana) holds an annual dog show in December. The 2024 edition (15 Dec 2024) drew more than 100 owners and the 2023 edition more than 125. Dog groomers, pet-food makers and pharma companies take part. Pet Fed held a Chandigarh stop at Elante Mall (24-25 Feb 2023) with 100+ stalls.
facts.value: >100 dog owners at GADVASU Dog Show 2024
facts.source_name: GADVASU news/activity pages; Curly Tales/IANS (Pet Fed)
facts.notes: No published stall price for either event. Contact GADVASU Dept of Veterinary Medicine for the Dec 2026 show; it is a high-density audience of engaged dog owners. Chandigarh Tourism open-space event sites rent at Rs 80,000 + GST (not Pet Fed specific).

facts.claim: Meta and Google ads invoiced by their Indian entity carry 18% GST, which is claimable as input credit only by GST-registered businesses. Invoices from Irish entities carry no Indian GST and need 18% IGST under reverse charge. The 6% Equalisation Levy on online ads was removed from 1 April 2025.
facts.source_name: TaxGarden (compliance blog)
facts.notes: For an unregistered bootstrapped founder, GST is a pure cost: multiply ad budgets by 1.18 in the model. A CA must confirm.

facts.claim: Chandigarh MC's Pet and Community Dogs Bylaws require registration of every dog over 4 months old and cap dogs by house size (5 marla: 1, 10 marla: 2, 12 marla: 3, 1 kanal: 4). An older Tribune report counted about 9,500 registered pet dogs in Chandigarh. Panchkula has also made registration mandatory.
facts.source_name: The Tribune (Chandigarh); News Arena
facts.notes: Sources disagree on whether the bylaws are dated 2023 or 2025; reported effective in late Oct 2025. Chandigarh also makes owners liable for dog-bite relief (Tribune), which matters for the walking service. The registration count date is unclear.

facts.claim: NPCI's new framework, effective 15 Oct 2026, charges a 0.4% MDR on person-to-merchant (P2M) UPI payments above Rs 2,000, capped at Rs 300 per transaction. Payments up to Rs 2,000 and P2P transfers stay free, and the merchant may not add MDR to the customer's bill. Small merchants in the 'P2PM' category, who receive up to Rs 1 lakh a month through UPI QR straight into their bank account, keep zero MDR on every payment whatever its size. A merchant is moved to P2M only after receiving more than Rs 1 lakh a month for 3 months in a row.
facts.value: 0.4% above Rs 2,000 (cap Rs 300); 0% for P2PM small merchants <= Rs 1 lakh/month
facts.source_name: Business Today (also Moneylife, Vyapar, Inc42 coverage of NPCI FAQ)
facts.notes: I did not see the NPCI circular itself, only consistent reports in reputable outlets. The rule takes effect 5 days after today. Impact on our prices if collected into a P2M merchant account: walking Rs 2,999 costs Rs 12 MDR and Rs 4,999 costs Rs 20, and Spa Rs 2,199/2,799 also falls above Rs 2,000. Grooms of Rs 2,000 or less are unaffected. An individual provider paid by direct QR who stays under Rs 1 lakh a month would likely be P2PM (zero MDR). Sources also say GST-registered merchants can claim ITC on GST paid on MDR. It is unclear how the rule applies to payments routed through a gateway or aggregator.

facts.claim: Razorpay charges a 2% platform fee plus 18% GST on most domestic methods, UPI and RuPay debit included, even though government MDR on those is zero. RuPay credit cards on UPI cost 2.15%, and Amex, Diners and corporate cards cost 3%. There is no setup fee and no annual maintenance charge.
facts.source_name: Razorpay blog - payment gateway pricing explained
facts.notes: This is the company's own blog, read in a 2026 search context. One third-party comparison (mewayz) says UPI is free, which conflicts with Razorpay's own page. Derived figures: the effective cost is 2.36% of GMV, about Rs 35 on a Rs 1,499 groom and about Rs 2.36 lakh on Rs 1 crore GMV if all of it goes through the gateway.

facts.claim: Newly activated Razorpay merchants pay no platform fee on eligible domestic transactions for 90 days or until Rs 5 lakh cumulative value, whichever comes first. GST and a Rs 199 + tax KYC processing fee are not waived. Prepaid cards, corporate cards, Amex, Diners and EMI are excluded.
facts.source_name: Razorpay blog + razorpay.com/terms/90-day-free-pg-offer/
facts.notes: The activation cutoff is inconsistent: the terms page says activated on or after 1 June 2026, while the blog says 1 July 2026. At our prices this saves at most about Rs 11,800 (2.36% of Rs 5 lakh). Activate close to launch so the 90 days are not wasted.

facts.claim: Under RBI's Sept 2025 PA Directions, Razorpay offers Route only to businesses whose domestic turnover exceeds Rs 40 lakh (or export turnover exceeds Rs 5 lakh) in the current or preceding financial year. GST-exempt and first-year businesses may self-declare turnover. A written payer-payee transparency declaration is also required, meaning the linked account (the provider) must deal directly with customers. Route access was disabled for merchants that missed the 31 Dec 2025 proofs deadline. As an alternative, Razorpay suggests a two-step flow: settle into your own account, then pay vendors.
facts.source_name: Razorpay Route FAQ (official docs)
facts.notes: The page refers to FY26 and the post-Dec-2025 compliance cutoff. This is decision-changing: at launch PetDoorStep will probably not meet Rs 40 lakh turnover, so automatic split payouts may not be available until GMV grows. A lawyer should confirm whether the suggested two-step flow (collect, then pay providers) is compliant for us.

facts.claim: Razorpay's worked example for Route transfers applies a 0.25% transfer fee plus 18% GST, on top of a 2% payment fee. The example uses a Rs 1,000 payment with Rs 100 platform commission.
facts.source_name: Razorpay docs - Route transfers and related fees example
facts.notes: The docs present this as an example, not a rate card, so the actual fee depends on the account. Instant settlement to linked accounts costs extra (amount not given). All-in, central collection plus split works out to about 2.25% + GST, roughly 2.66% of GMV.

facts.topic: Cashfree gateway and Easy Split pricing
facts.claim: Cashfree's standard domestic rate is 1.95% (cards, netbanking, wallets). Its limited-period 1.6% offer was valid until 31 Jul 2026. UPI is priced 'as per applicable law'. Easy Split (marketplace split) is listed at 0.2-0.25% of order value on top of collection charges. Vendors must complete KYC (PAN, bank account, business type, GST/CIN if any), and non-compliant vendors are blocked from settlement.
facts.source_name: Cashfree docs pricing; cashfree.com/easy-split/split-payment-gateway; cashfree.com/docs/payments/split/vendor/kyc.md
facts.notes: The 1.6% promo has expired. A user review claims UPI is charged at 0%, but this is unconfirmed. Cashfree is subject to the same RBI PA Directions, so a turnover criterion like Razorpay's may apply (not confirmed). Get a written quote.

facts.claim: RazorpayX payout fees per transfer are: IMPS/UPI Rs 4 below Rs 1,000; Rs 6 for Rs 1,000-25,000; Rs 9 above Rs 25,000; NEFT/RTGS Rs 5. GST is charged on top. Third-party sources put Cashfree payouts at about Rs 3-15 per transfer, varying by rail.
facts.source_name: RazorpayX Payouts page; precisiontech.in Cashfree partner page
facts.notes: A third-party summary mentions 250 free payouts a month (unverified). Weekly batched payouts to 30 providers would cost about 120 x Rs 6 x 1.18, roughly Rs 850 a month. A RazorpayX current account plan may add subscription fees (amounts not found).

facts.claim: RBI's consolidated PA Directions (15 Sep 2025) replace the 2020/2021/2023 guidelines. PAs must ensure that marketplaces they onboard do not accept payments on behalf of sellers who are not onboarded on the marketplace, and a PA may not run its own marketplace. Small merchants with turnover up to Rs 40 lakh (export up to Rs 5 lakh) get simplified due diligence: PAN or Form 60, one OVD and physical verification. Non-bank PAs need RBI authorisation, with minimum net owned funds of Rs 15 crore rising to Rs 25 crore.
facts.source_name: AZB & Partners note; Lexology summary; Vinod Kothari highlights
facts.notes: These are law-firm summaries; I did not read the RBI text. The Directions imply a marketplace can collect through an authorised PA for onboarded sellers, so PetDoorStep should not hold or settle customer funds itself outside a PA. Whether PetDoorStep collecting into its own account and then paying providers counts as unauthorised aggregation is a lawyer question.

facts.claim: Razorpay onboards unregistered individuals using their personal PAN, with no GST number required. The Individual business type pays a Rs 199 onboarding fee. A GST certificate becomes required once annual turnover exceeds Rs 20 lakh (Rs 10 lakh in special-category states).
facts.value: Rs 199 onboarding; GST above Rs 20 lakh
facts.source_name: Razorpay docs - Create a Razorpay Account / easy submit KYC
facts.notes: A PhonePe guide says unregistered accounts may start with lower limits, e.g. Rs 50,000, until more proof is given. This lets the founder start collecting commission or subscriptions before incorporation, though DPIIT and funding benefits need an entity.

facts.claim: PhonePe SmartSpeaker has two plans. The monthly plan costs Rs 318 one-time setup plus Rs 125 a month deducted from settlements. The zero-rental plan costs Rs 999 one-time (GST included) plus a Rs 25 monthly service fee. The premium voice option adds Rs 15 a month.
facts.source_name: PhonePe merchant help centre
facts.notes: A third-party table (Stashfin) gives Paytm at about Rs 99-149 a month and BharatPe at Rs 50-100 a month, both unverified and dated. A static business QR has no device cost, and a doorstep provider does not need a soundbox, so treat it as optional at Rs 0 in the low-cost case.

facts.topic: E-commerce operator TDS (194-O) and GST TCS (Sec 52)
facts.claim: Section 194-O TDS on e-commerce operators was cut from 1% to 0.1% from 1 Oct 2024. It rises to 5% without PAN, and resident individual participants with platform gross sales up to Rs 5 lakh who furnish PAN/Aadhaar are exempt. GST TCS under Section 52 was halved to 0.5% (0.25% CGST + 0.25% SGST) from 10 Jul 2024, and applies where the e-commerce operator collects the consideration.
facts.source_name: TaxGuru (194-O); gstgyaan.com / knowyourgst.com (Sec 52 text)
facts.notes: These sources are secondary; I did not read the notifications. Whether a doorstep-services marketplace where customers pay providers directly triggers 194-O (which can apply to payments made directly) or Sec 52 TCS (which applies where the operator collects) needs a CA. These are compliance and cash-flow items, not costs.

facts.topic: GST registration threshold for services and the e-commerce exemption
facts.claim: Service providers need not register for GST if their aggregate turnover stays within Rs 20 lakh (Rs 10 lakh in special-category states). Under Notification 65/2017-CT, suppliers of services through an e-commerce operator also get this threshold exemption from compulsory registration.
facts.source_name: GST Council registration flyer; GSTZen - Notification 65/2017
facts.notes: Punjab is not a special-category state, so the Rs 20 lakh limit applies (my inference; check). Individual groomers and walkers below Rs 20 lakh need no GST registration. Whether PetDoorStep itself must register compulsorily as an e-commerce operator (Sec 24) is a CA question.

facts.topic: Google Workspace Business Starter price, India
facts.claim: Google Workspace Business Starter lists at about Rs 270 per user per month in India plus 18% GST (Rs 318.60), or about Rs 3,240 per user per year on annual billing. Resellers advertise first-year promos as low as Rs 1,932 per user per year.
facts.source_name: Netspace India (reseller); StartupTalky; Precisiontech
facts.notes: Low is the Rs 1,932/yr promo divided by 12; high includes GST. A Cloudfy guide says the plans were restructured in 2025 and adds a 'Base' plan at Rs 99/user/month; sources disagree. A cheaper alternative is Zoho Mail Forever Free (up to 5 users, 1 domain, availability varies by region) or Mail Lite at about Rs 59-90/user/month from resellers.

facts.claim: Since July 2023, AppSheet Core licences come by default with domain-verified Google Workspace Business Starter, Standard and Plus editions. AppSheet's free tier lets you build prototypes and invite up to 10 test users at no cost. Paid standalone plans are about $5 (Starter) and $10 (Core) per user per month.
facts.value: Included in Workspace Business Starter; free for <=10 test users
facts.source_name: Google Workspace Updates blog; solutions.appsheet.com/pricing
facts.notes: The source is official but from 2023, and a third-party 2026 table says Starter does not include AppSheet, so check in the Admin Console. If Core is still included, Workspace at about Rs 319 per user plus Sheets gives a free internal ops app (booking board, provider app). AppSheet licenses app users, so provider-facing use may need licences per provider; confirm.

facts.claim: Glide's Maker plan costs $49 a month billed annually or $60 monthly. It includes 3 published apps and 500 updates a month, with extra updates at $0.02 each. Unlimited users are allowed only on personal or education email domains; work-email users need Business (about $199-249 a month).
facts.source_name: Jet Admin blog (competitor) - Glide pricing July 2026
facts.notes: This is a third-party, competitor-written source. Plan tiers (Free/Explorer/Maker/Business/Enterprise) date from about Nov 2025. With Gmail-based providers, Maker could serve a provider app for about Rs 4,200-5,200 a month. AppSheet inside Workspace is probably cheaper.

facts.claim: Zoho Bookings India prices, from a reseller, are: Free for 1 user, Basic Rs 300 and Premium Rs 500 per user per month billed annually. Jotform's free Starter allows 5 forms and 100 submissions a month, and Bronze costs $34 a month annually ($39 monthly) for 25 forms and 1,000 submissions. Calendly Free allows 1 event type, and Standard costs $10 per seat per month annually ($12-16 monthly).
facts.source_name: itforsme.in (Zoho partner); activepieces.com Jotform pricing 2026; capterra.com Calendly pricing
facts.notes: The Zoho figures come from a reseller and I did not see the official zoho.com/in page. Zoho One (whole suite) costs about Rs 1,250-1,500 per employee per month plus GST on the all-employee plan (codroiditlabs.com, itforsme.in). For a 1-2 person team, Google Forms plus WhatsApp is free and probably enough for months 1-6.

facts.claim: Zoho FSM in India has a free plan (2 users per one partner), Standard at Rs 1,000 and Professional at Rs 1,800 per user per month excluding GST; another partner quotes about Rs 1,400 per technician per month. Jobber Core is $49 a month for 1 user, extra users $29 each, and Connect is $139 a month for up to 5 users. Fieldproxy has been reported at Rs 400-800 per field user per month.
facts.source_name: PrecisionTech (Zoho partner); aaxonix.com; fieldproxy.ai Jobber pricing page; Outlook Business (Fieldproxy)
facts.notes: All figures come from partners or third parties. Per-technician FSM pricing scales badly for a marketplace with many part-time providers. At 30 providers x Rs 1,000 it would be Rs 30,000 a month, which is not viable early. Use only for the founder or dispatcher seat, or skip.

facts.claim: A .in domain costs about $2-4 for the first year and $5.50-10 a year to renew. Examples: Hostinger $2.99 first year / $9.99 renewal, HIOX India $4.14 / $8.81, cheapest renewal $5.50 at Above.com.
facts.source_name: domainoffer.net comparison (Jul 2026); cybernews.com best .in registrars
facts.notes: These are aggregator figures in USD. At the site's quoted Rs 96.38/$ they come to roughly Rs 290-960 a year (my conversion). Budget Rs 1,000 a year for renewal-safe planning, and check INR prices at an Indian registrar.

facts.claim: Cloudflare Pages' free plan allows 500 builds a month, 1 concurrent build, a 20-minute build timeout and up to 20,000 files per site. Official docs list no bandwidth cap, and third parties describe bandwidth as unmetered. Pages Functions count against the Workers free tier (about 100,000 requests a day).
facts.source_name: Cloudflare Pages limits (official docs)
facts.notes: The 'unlimited bandwidth' claim comes only from third parties. A static marketing site with a WhatsApp or booking-form CTA can run at zero hosting cost.

facts.claim: Meta's India rate for marketing templates is about Rs 0.86 per message excluding GST (up about 10% from 1 Jan 2026), and utility and authentication templates about Rs 0.115. Free-form replies inside the 24-hour customer-service window have been free. BSP platform plans (2026 audits) include AiSensy Basic Rs 1,500 a month, WATI Growth Rs 2,499 a month and Interakt Starter about Rs 3,499 a quarter.
facts.value: Rs 0.115 utility / Rs 0.86 marketing per message
facts.source_name: Monty Mobile / baat.ai / myoperator (rates); codingclave.com audits (BSP plans)
facts.notes: AiSensy and Free Press Journal report that Meta started charging service messages from 1 Oct 2026, with 1,000 free a month per WABA at about Rs 0.115-0.145 each. Meta's own page still shows service as free, so this is unverified. The free WhatsApp Business app is enough until roughly 300+ bookings a month.

facts.claim: Supabase's free tier gives 2 projects, a 500 MB Postgres database, 1 GB file storage and 50,000 auth MAU; free projects pause after a week of inactivity. Firebase phone-OTP sign-in has required the paid Blaze plan since Sept 2024, with per-SMS charges in India (first 10 SMS a day free). Email and social auth stay free up to 50,000 MAU.
facts.source_name: Jet Admin Supabase guide 2026; blog.logto.io Firebase auth pricing
facts.notes: These are third-party summaries. The India SMS price is quoted between $0.01 and $0.07 per SMS. This matters if a custom app is built later, because OTP SMS becomes a variable cost per signup.

facts.claim: Indian app development in 2026 runs about Rs 6-18 lakh for a lean MVP on one platform and Rs 20-55 lakh for a growth-stage iOS + Android product. Advanced feature sets (payments, geolocation, push) add Rs 1-3 lakh each, and complex modules (real-time chat, multi-tenant admin) add Rs 3-10 lakh+. A mid-tier Bengaluru agency quotes about Rs 24-38 lakh over 14-18 weeks.
facts.source_name: Riolabz (agency) 2026; rohitraj.tech notes (agency tiers)
facts.notes: Vendors wrote these and have an incentive to quote high. A three-sided marketplace (customer, provider, admin) sits at the upper-MVP to mid band. One generic India guide gives Rs 2-6 lakh for a 'mid-level app (e.g., food delivery)', which conflicts. Expect annual maintenance on top (not sourced here).

facts.topic: Custom app development cost - freelancer, consultant and clone scripts
facts.claim: An India-based consultant prices a 12-screen Flutter MVP (Firebase/Supabase auth, payments, push) at Rs 6.5-9.5 lakh over 5-8 weeks. India Flutter agency rates are about $25-60 an hour, with freelancers 15-30% lower. White-label 'UrbanClap clone' scripts start at about $999-1,499 for an MVP licence, excluding third-party APIs and hosting, against $12,000-25,000 for a custom MVP from the same vendor.
facts.source_name: rohitraj.tech (consultant); getwidget.dev rates; miracuves.com UrbanClap clone cost
facts.notes: All are self-interested vendor sources. Clone scripts bring lock-in, code-quality and security risk and still need customisation and hosting. This is the low-cost alternative to agency builds, best done only after no-code validation.

facts.claim: Apple Developer Program enrolment costs Rs 8,700 a year in India. Google Play developer registration is a one-time $25.
facts.source_name: Apple Developer Forums (user reports); vendor blog for Google Play fee
facts.notes: The Apple figure comes from Indian developers' forum posts, not an Apple price page. An Android-only provider app (most Ludhiana groomers use Android) avoids the Apple fee early on.

facts.claim: PMMY tiers are: Shishu up to Rs 50,000; Kishore Rs 50,000-5 lakh; Tarun Rs 5-10 lakh; Tarun Plus Rs 10-20 lakh. Tarun Plus took effect 24 Oct 2024 and is only for borrowers who have availed and repaid a Tarun loan. Loans are collateral-free and guaranteed by CGFMU up to Rs 20 lakh.
facts.source_name: PIB backgrounder (Oct 2024); Business Standard (Apr 2025)
facts.notes: A first-time borrower can realistically get Kishore (up to Rs 5 lakh) or Tarun (up to Rs 10 lakh); Tarun Plus is not available to new borrowers. A PIB document dated Apr 2026 marks year 11, and I found no tier changes since.

facts.claim: MUDRA rates are benchmark-linked (EBLR/MCLR). Guides cite about 8.5-12% a year at PSU banks for good profiles and up to 20% at some lenders. Union Bank charges EBLR + 1.75% (up to Rs 2 lakh) and EBLR + 2.75% (above Rs 2 lakh). SBI charges no processing fee on Shishu and Kishore and 0.50% on Tarun. Tenure is up to 5 years for Shishu/Kishore and up to 7 years for Tarun.
facts.source_name: Godrej Capital guide 2025-26; Paisabazaar SBI Mudra page; BankBazaar 2026
facts.notes: SBI does not publish its MUDRA spread. Paisabazaar mentions a 20% margin on Kishore at SBI, meaning the borrower's own contribution may be needed (verify). Use 10-12% in the model for a Kishore working-capital loan.

facts.claim: Under PMEGP, the maximum project cost for service units is Rs 20 lakh. The margin-money subsidy is 15% urban / 25% rural for general category and 25% urban / 35% rural for special categories. Own contribution is 10% (general) or 5% (special). The scheme was approved for 2021-22 to 2025-26, and I found no notice extending it to 2026-27.
facts.value: 15% urban general subsidy on up to Rs 20 lakh
facts.source_name: KVIC revised PMEGP guidelines; Bank of Maharashtra PMEGP page; Cashfree blog
facts.notes: Derived: the maximum urban subsidy is Rs 3 lakh (general) or Rs 5 lakh (special category, which includes women and SC/ST). PMEGP is built for new capital projects and requires EDP training, so an asset-light marketplace may struggle to show eligible project cost. Its status after March 2026 is unconfirmed.

facts.topic: Stand-Up India and the first-time entrepreneur scheme
facts.claim: Stand-Up India gives bank loans of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprises to SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs, who must hold 51% of non-individual entities. The scheme was extended only up to 2025 and reportedly ended March 2025, pending a relaunch. Budget 2025-26 announced a new scheme of term loans up to Rs 2 crore for 5 lakh first-time women, SC and ST entrepreneurs; I found no evidence it has launched.
facts.source_name: SBI Stand-Up India page; Outlook Money (Budget 2025); telanganatoday tag page (relaunch)
facts.notes: This only applies if a founder or majority shareholder is a woman or SC/ST. Do not count on it in the base model.

facts.claim: From 1 Apr 2025 CGTMSE guarantees collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises up to Rs 10 crore. Cover is 85% for micro enterprises up to Rs 5 lakh and 75% above that, with higher cover for women and SC/ST and +5 points in credit-deficient districts. The borrower pays an annual guarantee fee, kept low for loans up to Rs 10 lakh.
facts.source_name: Bajaj Finserv CGTMSE guide (Dec 2025); Poonawalla Fincorp
facts.notes: These are lender blogs and I did not find the current fee schedule. CGTMSE is relevant if PetDoorStep borrows above the MUDRA limits; it needs Udyam registration.

facts.claim: SISFS pays through approved incubators: grants up to Rs 20 lakh for proof of concept, prototype and trials, plus up to Rs 50 lakh as convertible debentures or debt for market entry. It is for DPIIT-recognised startups incorporated less than 2 years before applying. The original Rs 945 crore scheme covered 2021-25. Its 2026 status is unclear: an aggregator lists it open but reports the last cycle closing 31 May 2026, and DPIIT was pushing for a revival in late 2025.
facts.value: Up to Rs 20 lakh grant + Rs 50 lakh debt
facts.source_name: Bajaj Finserv explainer (Apr 2026); beststartup.in (Jul 2026); Entrepreneur India (DPIIT revival push)
facts.notes: Status is unconfirmed. The incorporation clock (under 2 years) means incorporating too early can lose eligibility. Check seedfund.startupindia.gov.in and whether VLIIF or CIIF are SISFS incubators.

facts.claim: Punjab's Industrial and Business Development Policy 2022 offers startups: a seed grant up to Rs 3 lakh via state/centre-recognised incubators; an 8% a year interest subsidy for 5 years on bank loans, capped at Rs 5 lakh a year; reimbursement of 25% of lease rent for 1 year, capped at Rs 3 lakh, for startups in incubators, IT parks or notified locations; and 100% stamp-duty reimbursement on MoA/AoA registration for Startup Punjab-registered startups.
facts.value: Seed Rs 3 lakh; 8% interest subsidy; 25% lease rent
facts.source_name: Startup India - Punjab state policy page; Startup India SRF 2026 Punjab report; Grant Thornton deck
facts.notes: The policy reportedly runs to 16 Oct 2027 (StartupFeed). The 8% interest subsidy could largely offset a MUDRA loan's interest, making a Rs 5 lakh Kishore loan at about 10% nearly 2% net (derived; verify that MUDRA loans qualify). A third-party site claims seed up to Rs 15 lakh, which conflicts with the official page.

facts.topic: Punjab seed grant raised to Rs 5 lakh
facts.claim: In June 2026 CM Bhagwant Mann announced the Punjab startup seed grant had been raised from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 5 lakh. He disbursed Rs 1.07 crore to 31 startups: 7 at Rs 5 lakh and 24 at Rs 3 lakh.
facts.source_name: The Tribune; UNI India; StartupFeed (Oct 2026 still says Rs 3 lakh)
facts.notes: Official guidance may not yet reflect Rs 5 lakh. Use Rs 3 lakh in the base case and Rs 5 lakh as upside. Applications go through a recognised incubator.

facts.claim: The Chandigarh Startup Policy 2025 has a grant-based seed fund with a Rs 10 crore annual corpus (Rs 50 crore over 5 years). Up to 20 seed-stage startups get up to Rs 7 lakh each, with an extra Rs 2 lakh for women-led or transgender-founded ventures. Up to 20 early-growth startups get up to Rs 12 lakh each.
facts.value: Up to Rs 7 lakh (seed) / Rs 12 lakh (growth)
facts.source_name: The Tribune; Startup India SRF 2026 Chandigarh report
facts.notes: Eligibility probably requires a Chandigarh UT-registered or operating startup, not Ludhiana. Relevant only once Tricity operations exist.

facts.claim: GADVASU's Veterinary Livestock Innovation and Incubation Foundation (VLIIF), a DST-NIDHI Inclusive Technology Business Incubator in Ludhiana, gives ignition grants of up to Rs 10 lakh per startup under DST criteria. It reports 28 startups incubated and Rs 50 lakh of ignition grants given. It has signed an MoU with Ludhiana Angels Network for mentoring and early-stage funding access, and applications go through vliif.com.
facts.value: Ignition grant up to Rs 10 lakh
facts.source_name: GADVASU news; The Tribune (VLIIF agreements with startups)
facts.notes: This is the best-fit local incubator, since it sits inside the veterinary university and can link to vet providers. A recent cohort includes 'JustBark', which may be pet-related (unconfirmed; possible competitor or partner). DST ignition grants usually expect technology innovation, so a services marketplace may need to present a tech angle such as health records or tele-triage.

facts.claim: PAU's Punjab Agri Business Incubator (RKVY-RAFTAAR) runs UDDAM, a pre-seed programme with grants up to Rs 5 lakh, and UDAAN, an incubation programme for startups with an MVP, with grants up to Rs 25 lakh. PABI reports training 250+ startups and funding 92 with Rs 11.5 crore+.
facts.source_name: StartupGrants India provider listing; incorpx.io UDDAM 2026 listing
facts.notes: The focus is agriculture and allied sectors, so it is unclear whether companion-animal services qualify (livestock and allied might). Another listing says up to Rs 4 lakh for student teams.

facts.claim: Chitkara Innovation Incubator Foundation (DST TBI, Rajpura) runs a DST NIDHI Seed Support Program offering Rs 10-25 lakh (higher in exceptional cases) as equity, convertible instruments or debt. Eligible startups are India-registered companies, preferably DPIIT-recognised, with at least 3 months in a CIIF resident or virtual programme. Equity exit is considered in 3-5 years. CIIF reports funding 101 startups.
facts.source_name: Chitkara University CIIF NIDHI-SSP page
facts.notes: This is not a grant: it is equity, convertible or debt, so model it as dilution. A private limited company is needed. IIT Ropar iHub-AWaDH grants (Rs 5-10 lakh) are agri/water-focused and their 2025 calls are closed, so they are a poor fit.

facts.claim: Ludhiana Angels Network is an LLP set up in 2024 at the BCM campus, Sector 32, Ludhiana, focused on manufacturing and supply chain but technology-agnostic. Its Fuelerator 3.0 programme (Rs 1,000 application fee, deadline 30 Aug 2026) shortlisted 30 startups and selected 4 for Rs 50 lakh equity funding each.
facts.value: Rs 50 lakh equity per selected startup
facts.source_name: StartupGrants India listing (not LAN's own site)
facts.notes: The 2026 cycle has closed; target the next one. Chandigarh Angels Network has 40+ investors and has backed about 15 startups in 3 years (Inc42); its typical cheque was not found.

facts.claim: Typical Indian pre-seed cheques are about Rs 5-25 lakh, mostly from angels, and founders usually give up about 15-20% equity at pre-revenue seed.
facts.source_name: eChai Ventures founder guide
facts.notes: This is a community guide, not a dataset. Other sources give Rs 50 lakh-2.5 crore for a first external round. Treat it as a planning benchmark only.

facts.claim: Section 80-IAC gives eligible DPIIT-recognised startups a 100% deduction of profits for any 3 consecutive years out of 10. Only private limited companies and LLPs incorporated between 1 Apr 2016 and before 1 Apr 2030 with turnover up to Rs 100 crore qualify, and an Inter-Ministerial Board certificate is required. Over 3,700 startups had been approved by 2025.
facts.source_name: News On AIR (May 2025); taxaj.com (Finance Act 2025 extension)
facts.notes: This is low near-term value because early years are loss-making. Incorporating as a Pvt Ltd or LLP keeps DPIIT, SISFS and CIIF routes open, while a proprietorship cannot claim 80-IAC.
